content:
The next major iPhone software version is iOS 27, and it's coming soon. Here's what we know about the expected public release timing for iOS 27.

iOS 27 launches in September, likely in the middle of the month.

iOS 27 is the next major software release for iPhone, and it's been in beta testing all summer.

After months of beta testing, Apple has always released its major new iOS versions to all users in September.

Therefore, iOS 27 is expected to launch in September, likely in the middle of the month.

Here are the iOS release dates from Apple over the past few years:

  • iOS 26: September 15 (Monday)
  • iOS 18: September 16 (Monday)
  • iOS 17: September 18 (Monday)
  • iOS 16: September 12 (Monday)

Based on this pattern, iOS 27 is expected to launch on or around September 14 (Monday).

The official date is usually announced at Apple's annual iPhone event, which generally takes place the week before. The iPhone 18 Pro is currently expected to debut on or around September 9.

iOS 27 brings new features to Wallet, Photos, Messages, Notes, and more, with upgrades to CarPlay and AirPods, plus a major Siri AI overhaul and other changes.

This update will be compatible with all iPhone models that supported iOS 26.

Which new features and changes in iOS 27 are you most looking forward to? Let us know in the comments section.
